rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to refer to a person who rides a bicycle.

example.english: I saw a cyclist in the park yesterday.
example.traditional: 我尋日喺公園見到一個踩單車嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 caai2 daan1 ce1 ge3 jan4

rows.note: A speaker uses this especially for a racing or serious cyclist rather than an ordinary bicycle rider.

example.english: That cyclist is preparing to take part in next month's race.
example.traditional: 嗰個單車手準備參加下個月嘅比賽。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 daan1 ce1 sau2 zeon2 bei6 caam1 gaa1 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 bei2 coi3
